rules.root_discovery: Extractor roots unlock when company.level reaches their family level.
rules.chain_mastery: A downstream option unlocks only after every direct input option is unlocked and the lifetime amount for every direct input is met.
rules.company_level_derivation: Downstream company_level is the maximum level among all extractor-root ancestor families.
rules.primary_family_derivation: family is the latest-gated ancestor family; extractor_families is the authoritative complete family set.
rules.cross_family: All ancestor families must be discovered; all direct input options and direct-input lifetime gates must be satisfied.
rules.visibility: Locked entries remain visible in Production Guide; Factory Resource Selection remains unlocked-only.

families.name: Base Metals & Carbon
families.rationale: Preserves the proven metal-and-energy core of the current start set.
families.progression_role: Feeds steel, copper, aluminium and the first broad industrial chains.

families.name: Construction Minerals
families.rationale: Keeps basic construction and silicon-adjacent materials available from the start.
families.progression_role: Introduces mineral processing without adding another unlock step to the tutorial.

families.name: Forestry
families.rationale: Retains the existing renewable-material starting branch.
families.progression_role: Provides an early non-mining chain and packaging/construction inputs.

families.name: Staple Agriculture
families.rationale: Retains the single, readable food-chain entry point already present at game start.
families.progression_role: Teaches agricultural processing before the wider crop catalog appears.

families.name: Petroleum
families.rationale: Retains the existing petrochemical starting branch used by many later products.
families.progression_role: Seeds fuels, polymers and cross-family industrial recipes.

families.name: Field Crops
families.rationale: Adds familiar bulk crops immediately after the tutorial without exposing specialty industry.
families.progression_role: Broadens food, starch, oil and biochemical routes.

families.name: Process Minerals
families.rationale: Groups common mineral feedstocks used by glass, ceramics and construction.
families.progression_role: Opens the first substantial construction and ceramic expansion.

families.name: Food & Fiber Crops
families.rationale: Follows staple crops with consumer-food, textile and plant-oil inputs.
families.progression_role: Expands consumer goods while keeping advanced industry gated.

families.name: Gas & Elastomers
families.rationale: Pairs the second fossil feedstock with the natural elastic material branch.
families.progression_role: Adds gas energy, chemicals, tires and flexible industrial components.

families.name: Chemical Minerals
families.rationale: Collects bulk mineral inputs whose main value is chemical conversion.
families.progression_role: Unlocks fertilizers, acids and larger chemical cross-family chains.

families.name: Common Alloy Metals
families.rationale: Introduces widely used alloying and protective metals before specialist metallurgy.
families.progression_role: Deepens metal fabrication and unlocks durable mid-game components.

families.name: Advanced Alloy Metals
families.rationale: Delays high-performance alloy inputs until the ordinary metal loop is established.
families.progression_role: Enables stainless and heat-resistant mid-game production.

families.name: Carbon & Specialty Minerals
families.rationale: Groups specialist non-metal feedstocks used across refractories, chemistry and electronics.
families.progression_role: Bridges established industries into advanced material recipes.

families.name: Battery & Electronics Feedstocks
families.rationale: Keeps modern energy-storage and electronics inputs out of the early catalog.
families.progression_role: Starts advanced batteries, control systems and electronics chains.

families.name: Precious Metals
families.rationale: Places valuable conductive metals after the core electronics feedstocks.
families.progression_role: Adds premium electronics, instruments and high-value market outputs.

families.name: Catalyst Precious Metals
families.rationale: Separates rare catalytic metals from the earlier gold/silver economy.
families.progression_role: Enables advanced catalysts, chemical systems and late components.

families.name: Aerospace & Refractory Metals
families.rationale: Reserves the strongest specialist metals for established industrial companies.
families.progression_role: Feeds aerospace, extreme-temperature and top-tier machinery chains.

families.name: Nuclear Materials
families.rationale: Aligns the final baseline raw-material discovery with the existing Industrialist title milestone.
families.progression_role: Opens nuclear fuel and the final energy/advanced-technology branch.
